# PR #2905: Patch: card animations for the Core set

Closes #2793

This fills in Core's card animation table, `apps/web/src/fx/cards/core.json5`, for #2782. The change is presentation only (CLAUDE.md rule 7): the engine, the catalog, the rulings and the wire are untouched.

## What changed

- **The table.** 87 of Core's 100 cards now have an entry other than `none`, against a floor of 55 (91 of 111 counting tokens).
  - Every Spell, Field Spell, Trap and Field Trap has a `cast` entry, its own recipe or a set piece.
  - All 16 Field Spells have an `aura`. #14 and #46 keep the auras they already had and gain a cast.
  - The six entries that already existed are unchanged: Flood, Hinder, Blood Bean, Lunar Eclipse, Twisting Nether and Ceaseless Void.
- **Three new shared motifs**, each for an event that no motif read and that shows up on 3 or more Core cards:
  - `send` reads `addedToHand` and `shuffledIn` (13 cards).
  - `radiance` reads `radiantSet` (6 cards).
  - `mend` reads `healed` (3 cards).

  None of them replaces anything, so each event's own animation still plays. Each has a gallery fixture, pinned cues in `motifs.test.ts` and a shake value in `FX_MOTIF_TRAUMA`. The issue asked for new motifs in their own commit, but the harness makes one commit for the whole run.
- **Three bespoke flourishes** in `fx/cards/core/`, built only from the existing motif pieces (bursts, shots, rings, rays, sheens, card-back flights and shakes) at the card's own scale. The reasons are in the table under "Bespoke flourishes" below.
- **`fx/cards/core.md`** is the per-card table, generated from the census plus the overrides. It is reproduced at the end of this description.
- **`fx/cards/core.test.ts`** is the per-set test. It checks:
  - the 55% floor (`FX_SET_PASS_FLOOR`);
  - a cast on every non-Unit and an aura on every Field Spell;
  - that every hook names a drawn motif;
  - that every play's motif draws on its gallery fixture;
  - that a hidden play keys no entry (R202);
  - that `core.md` matches the table row by row.
- **The `/dev/fx` gallery now plays every entry other than `none`.** `galleryPlayOf` in `fx/motifs/gallery.ts` sorts each entry into one of five kinds:
  - `board`: a motif on `cast` or `cry`, played through the real board.
  - `director`: a motif on `death`, `trigger` or `activate`, played through the gallery's own effects player, since the board does not draw those hooks yet.
  - `recipe`: a bespoke recipe, played on its fixture.
  - `setPiece`: a set piece, played on its hook marker and the wipe fixture.
  - `aura`: an aura alone.

  A Field card plays standing face up in the viewer's first backrow zone (`galleryFieldView`), so its aura shows.
- **New constants** in `fx/constants.ts`: `FX_TIDE_TRAUMA`, `FX_WISH_TRAUMA`, `FX_FORGE_TRAUMA`, `FX_FORGE_REACH` and `FX_SET_PASS_FLOOR`, all pinned in `constants.test.ts`.
- **`docs/polish/9-card-animations.md`** gains:
  - a "Drawn in #2793" table for the new motifs;
  - Core's flourishes under Tiers;
  - an "A set's pass" section;
  - the gallery's five kinds of play;
  - an updated example block.

- Not run: `cargo fmt`, `clippy` and `cargo test`, since no Rust changed; the e2e hotseat smoke, which CI's `e2e smoke` covers; and `/dev/fx` in a real browser.

## Decisions the issue did not settle

- **`fusionForge` draws everything when the fuse is reported.** The plan put the forge on the fuse and the card's flight to the hand on the hand event. But the engine adds the card to the hand before it reports the fuse (`subsystems/fuse.rs`), so the plan's version would fly the card before forging it. Now the flight to the hand comes after the forge, and the gallery fixture follows the engine's order.
- **`radiance` plays its rays once per play, not once per entry.** Otherwise a play that makes a whole hand Radiant, one entry per card, would flash rays on every card. A test covers it.
- **No Legendary entrance or Mythic takeover is restyled,** so R2722001 is not amended and there is no ruling note. The issue allows restyling but does not require it, and #2803 is reworking the shared ones.
- **When to add a motif.** The doc's "When to add a motif" rule lives in #2782's text, not in the repo. I used "3 or more cards with an event no motif reads" and wrote that into the doc. A person should confirm the rule.
- **`death`, `trigger`, `activate` and Trap `cast` entries draw nothing on the real board yet.** The board draws motifs only on `cast` and `cry`, and a Trap's firing opens no play. The gallery plays the 7 Core director entries through its own player. Wiring the board to those hooks is framework work, so I left it out.
- **`cardFixtureEvents` is removed.** `galleryCardEvents` replaces it and nothing else used it.
- **The gallery test plans all 91 Core entries instead of clicking each one.** Clicking all 91 in the UI ran past vitest's 5-second timeout, and raising a timeout isn't allowed.
  - One test plans every entry the way the board does.
  - A second clicks one card of each kind and checks that #14's storm aura shows.
  - A third clicks Twisting Nether and checks the board shows its `nether` set piece.

No expectation was loosened.

- In `cues.test.ts`, "B13 planFx flies … fire from a remembered caster's hero" and "R200 a spell's lethal bolt flies again …" used core-070, which now bolts. They now use `classicplus-015`, a Physical Spell still at `none`. Classic+'s pass must keep that card drawing nothing on damage, or re-point these two; a comment says so.
- In `cues.test.ts`, "B21 an event with hidden ids plans deep-equal cues …" used core-071 as its resolving play, which now snaps. It now uses core-020.
- In `tables.test.ts`, the "R2787000 the ten example Field Spells …" test now compares only each entry's aura, since #14 and #46 also have casts.
- In `motifs.test.ts`, the "card with no entry" baseline moved from core-016, which now bolts, to core-008.
- In `fx.test.tsx`, the gallery list length went from 16 to 121. That is Core's 91 non-`none` entries plus the other sets' 15 motif cards, 8 aura-only Field Spells, Crushing Walls, 5 set pieces and Training Grounds #30. The comment spells this out.

## Worth a second look

- **Field Spell casts.** A Field Spell's `cast: conjure` draws on the spell's own arrival in the backrow. I confirmed in the pinned AI fixtures (`crates/ai/tests/fixtures/pinned-*.json`) that playing a Field Spell emits that event. The census leaves it out because it skips events on the card itself.
- **Units with `cry: conjure`.** The summoning circle also plays on the Unit's own landing, which shares the play's entry (#12, #15, #61, #67).
